==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There is a man in a silver tube. The man is a superhero. But he has been corrupted by the power of the tube. I am studying readings from the tube. I can't recall if I was corrupting or cleansing him. I do remember staying awake for hours analyzing data.

I definitely had a false awakening during this dream. I recall having to go to sleep from within the dream. It is odd being able to sleep and wake up in dreams.
